FN-Q7KK54-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 37
Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/20/2023
Senate Bill 37 as introduced could reduce potential receipts to boards, agencies, commissions,
and other entities that issue professional licenses or certificates by an undetermined amount
dependent on the amount of fees waived for spouses of individuals employed in Alabama as
civil servants by the United States Department of Defense that seek reciprocal licensure
pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
